title: Arkret Seal
description: Wire shape of a Arkret CBS Seal. It finalizes only control-plane Events. `delta[]` is the canonical set of new control-plane event_digest values introduced by this Seal; cumulative coverage is derived recursively as covered_set(S)=set(S.delta) union covered_set(predecessor_refs[]). `control_event_set_root` authenticates that recursive covered_set and is used for basis, inclusion and non-membership proofs. Optional data_* roots are observational only and MUST NOT gate DataEvents. Identity & signature model (see zh/authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md §6): the typed `id` (`ak:seal:<digest-suite>:<hex>`, the registered special form) is content-derived — its hex equals H(seal_canonical_bytes) under the Realm digest_algorithm. Seal canonical bytes are the canonical JSON of every signed top-level field EXCEPT id and notary_signature. The `notary_signature` is NOT part of canonical bytes. Receivers MUST recompute H(seal_canonical_bytes) and verify the notary signature over the same bytes.

id.description: Content-derived typed reference. hex part MUST equal H(seal_canonical_bytes) under the Realm digest_algorithm, where seal_canonical_bytes is the canonical JSON of every signed body field EXCEPT `id` and `notary_signature`. Receivers MUST recompute and verify; mismatch → digest_mismatch. NEVER include `id` in the hash input — that would create a self-reference.

delta.description: Canonical bytewise-sorted set of new control-plane event_digest values introduced by this Seal. DataEvent digests MUST NOT appear here. Receivers MUST reject the Seal if any delta entry is already covered by a predecessor, if any entry is not a known valid Control Move digest, or if the list is not canonical sorted and duplicate-free.

control_event_set_root.description: Authenticated root over the recursive covered_set of this Seal. Default construction is RFC6962 Merkle root over canonical bytewise-sorted covered_set(S); inclusion uses Merkle audit path and non-membership uses sorted-neighbor proof. The root is not computed over delta[] alone.

state_root.description: Merkle root of control-plane cell state only.

completeness_root.description: Control-plane per-actor interval / chain-head completeness commitment. It does not prove absence of unknown actors.

notary_seq.description: Per-signer or committee slot sequence used for equivocation detection. Same signer and same realm_id MUST NOT sign two different canonical Seal bodies with the same notary_seq.

data_view_root.description: Optional observational root of KeyView records keyed by data cell id. It is not a DataEvent admission gate.

data_event_set_root.description: Optional observational root over DataEvent digests seen in this seal window. Missing DataEvents are not invalid.

availability_receipt_digests.description: Canonical bytewise-sorted, duplicate-free full canonical content digests of every and only AvailabilityReceipt required for this Seal's delta admission. Empty when no receipt is required. The receiver resolves every digest through the registered governance-dependency surface and verifies the full signed receipt; missing or surplus receipts reject the Seal. This list replaces the redundant availability_root.

covered_event_digests.description: Optional compaction materialization of the full recursive covered_set(S), canonical bytewise-sorted and duplicate-free. When present, receivers MUST verify it equals set(delta) union all predecessor covered sets and that control_event_set_root is computed over this exact set. Non-compaction Seals normally omit it.

previous_state_root.description: Hash-algorithm transition only: present iff this Seal is a Transition Seal under ak.profile.hash_transition.v1. It commits the governance view before the transition Move is applied, computed with previous_digest_algorithm. state_root commits the post-transition governance view with the new suite. See event-auth-state-resolution.md §9.3.2.

previous_digest_algorithm.description: Canonical active digest-suite id used for previous_state_root. Required iff previous_state_root is present, absent on non-transition Seals, and byte-equal to the transition Move from_digest_algorithm. A profile id is invalid here.

notary_signature.description: Signature over seal_canonical_bytes (every signed body field EXCEPT id and notary_signature). Verification uses only predecessor-state frozen notary signer descriptors. Each compact JWS protected header alg must equal the descriptor jose_algorithm; none, unknown crit headers, non-canonical signature encodings and key-kind/algorithm mismatch are rejected. Threshold/open-set/mixed use canonical multi_signature entries matched to distinct frozen descriptors and apply the predecessor-state threshold/profile rule. Seal is not an Event Envelope, so each signature payload_digest equals H(seal_canonical_bytes).

sealed_at.description: Normative notary commit timestamp covered by the Seal signature transcript. It is the time input for revocation_freshness_window_ms, recovery_witness_freshness_window_ms, proposal_intake_sla_ms, and reducer-derived projection timestamps. It MUST be >= every predecessor Seal.sealed_at. A value beyond verifier wall time + hard_future_skew_ms produces non-terminal seal_deferred_future_skew and MUST be retried as the clock advances; it is not a permanent rejection or a lattice winner input.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the signing key. Bare DID is not valid for signatures because verifiers need a stable verification method, not only a controller DID.

payload_digest.description: Hash of seal_canonical_bytes for this non-Event Seal signature. Do not rename to event_digest: event_digest is reserved for Event Envelope proofs.

signature.description: Compact JWS over the exact Seal signing core. The protected header MUST contain alg equal to the matched frozen descriptor jose_algorithm and kid equal to verification_method. alg=none, unknown crit parameters, non-canonical protected JSON/base64url, non-canonical ECDSA encoding, and key_kind/alg mismatch are rejected. Seal sealed_at is already signed in the body; this wrapper has no duplicate created_at.

signatures.description: Canonical bytewise order by verification_method, with each method appearing exactly once. Each compact JWS protected kid equals its signature.verification_method and protected alg equals the matched frozen descriptor jose_algorithm. threshold/open_set/mixed verifiers match entries to distinct predecessor-state frozen signer descriptors and apply that state's rule.
